rules.title: Stop sensors when the need ends
rules.what: Stop location, motion and Bluetooth updates when the screen or task that needed them goes away; request the coarsest accuracy that works.
rules.why: Sensors keep power-hungry hardware awake; started and never stopped, they drain the battery in the background.
rules.how: Pair start/stop in onAppear/onDisappear (or viewWillDisappear); desiredAccuracy as low as acceptable; significant-change monitoring over continuous updates.

patterns.note: Sensor started in a file with no matching stop call.

verify.how: Instruments Energy Log shows the sensor off after leaving the screen.

rules.title: Refresh on events, invalidate timers
rules.what: Refresh from push, WebSocket or delegate callbacks rather than repeating timers; invalidate any timer when its view disappears.
rules.why: A polling timer wakes the radio whether or not anything changed and keeps the device out of low-power states.
rules.how: Push notifications or URLSessionWebSocketTask; Timer with tolerance set, invalidated in deinit/onDisappear.

patterns.note: Timer in a file that never invalidates one.

verify.how: Each repeating timer is invalidated and its interval justified.

rules.title: Keep the main thread free
rules.what: Do not wait synchronously on the main thread (DispatchQueue.main.sync, semaphores, waitUntilFinished); move work to a background task.
rules.why: A blocked main thread freezes the interface; users tap again and queue more work for the same result.
rules.how: Task { await ... } or a background queue, then update the UI on the main actor.

patterns.note: Synchronous wait; harmful on the main thread.

verify.how: Main Thread Checker and hang detection report no hang on the journey.

rules.title: Stream downloads, share one session
rules.what: Download large payloads as streams or download tasks rather than Data(contentsOf:); share one configured URLSession instead of one per request.
rules.why: Data(contentsOf:) loads everything before use and blocks; a session per request loses its connection pool and cache, keeping the radio awake longer.
rules.how: URLSession.shared or a static session with cache policy and timeouts; bytes(for:) or downloadTask for large bodies.

patterns.note: Whole-content read; synchronous and unbounded for remote URLs.
Session built here; a static let or lazy var is the recommendation.

verify.how: Large downloads streamed; one session reused.

rules.title: Batch sync under good conditions
rules.what: Batch synchronisation and background refresh, schedule them under suitable power and network conditions, and make uploads resumable.
rules.why: Frequent small syncs wake the radio each time; failed uploads that restart from zero resend the same data.
rules.how: BGTaskScheduler with requiresExternalPower/requiresNetworkConnectivity where acceptable; background URLSession for resumable transfers.

verify.how: Sync frequency and conditions documented; retries resume.
